registryAssessment: The national General Authority for Lands, Survey & Urban Planning (GALSUP) is responsible for land and real-estate registration, and Yemeni law recognizes land/register records. The official National Information Center contacts page lists an Ibb coordination office, but that is an information-center office, not evidence of a local land-registry branch. No official city-specific GALSUP Ibb office/service evidence was verified, so local registry presence remains unresolved.

officialPrimarySources.observation: The official GALSUP site is the national authority portal and publishes land-authority notices; no Ibb-specific registry or map service was identified in the reviewed material.
The official Ministry of Justice land/real-estate law is national legal background, not proof of an Ibb city registry or open geometry.
The official Yemen National Information Center lists an Ibb coordination-office address at the governorate building in Al Dhihar; this is the center’s own local office, not a land registry.
